```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE}
#load in packages
library(rio)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
#bring in the counts by coc by year
#we can see that years before 2025 do not have the descriptions of location
coc2024 <- import("pit_CoC(2024).csv")
coc2025 <- import("pit_CoC(2025).csv")
```

```{r}
#pull the overall homeless and the location type
coc25_prename <- coc2025 %>% 
  select(1, 3, 4, 5, 133, 165) 

#rename them so we can work with them 
coc25 <- coc25_prename %>% 
  rename("cocnum" = 1,
         "coc_loc_type" = 2,
         "count_type" = 3,
         "overall_homeless_2025" = 4,
         "sheltered_homeless_2025" = 5,
         "unsheltered_homless_2025" = 6) 
```


```{r}
ree <- coc25 %>% 
  select(1,2,3, 47)
```
